title: agropyron elongatum subsp. corsicum
intro: Agropyron elongatum subsp. corsicum, commonly known as Corsican wheatgrass, is a perennial grass native to the Mediterranean region. It possesses numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Corsican wheatgrass include wound healing, antioxidant activity, and the inhibition of cancer cell growth, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Corsican wheatgrass contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a valuable plant for medicinal and pharmaceutical applications.
